chunks: And for you in retribution is life, O men of sense, that you may take heed.

key_terms.الْقِصَاصِ: Retribution or equal punishment in Islamic law
key_terms.تَتَّقُونَ: You may become God-conscious or take heed
key_terms.حَيَاةٌ: Life, implying preservation of life through justice

ai.seo_question: What is the significance of Qisas in preserving life according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted to mean that the implementation of Qisas preserves the life of the victim's family by preventing endless blood feuds, thereby granting them 'life' in a social and spiritual sense. The address to 'Ahl al-Albab' (people of intellect) underscores that rational understanding of justice leads to Taqwa, a theme central to Al-Kulayni’s and Al-Tabarsi’s commentaries on the practical wisdom of Islamic penal law.
